defaultTagline: Plant a seed tonight and carve what comes up for a friend.

events.name: Full Moon
events.caption: A full moon rises. Legendary luck is in the air.

events.name: Crow Visit
events.caption: A curious crow drops by to inspect your vine.

events.name: Thunderstorm
events.caption: Thunder rolls over the patch. Your vine holds on.

events.name: Shooting Star
events.caption: A shooting star! Make a wish for something rare.

events.name: Firefly Swarm
events.caption: A swarm of fireflies drifts in to light your vine.

events.name: Ghost Parade
events.caption: A parade of friendly ghosts floats by to say boo.

varieties.name: Classic Orange
varieties.blurb: On every porch, already grinning before it's carved.

varieties.name: Sweet Dumpling
varieties.blurb: Fits in a coat pocket, with green stripes on every rib.

varieties.name: Cinderella
varieties.blurb: Flat and red, waiting for a fairy godmother.

varieties.name: Golden Nugget
varieties.blurb: Fits in one hand. Bakes into exactly one pie.

varieties.name: Speckled Hound
varieties.blurb: Orange with green freckles, always first to the porch.

varieties.name: Casper
varieties.blurb: Pearly white and a little bit haunted.

varieties.name: Warty Goblin
varieties.blurb: Every wart came free with the seed.

varieties.name: Turk's Turban
varieties.blurb: Grew its own hat and won't take it off.

varieties.name: Peanut
varieties.blurb: Warts like peanut shells. It's nut-free.

varieties.name: Moss Monster
varieties.blurb: Moss on top, tiny mushrooms underneath.

varieties.name: Jarrahdale
varieties.blurb: Slate blue. Old gardeners still talk about it.

varieties.name: Midnight
varieties.blurb: Black as a night with no moon. Carve with the lights on.

varieties.name: Candy Stripe
varieties.blurb: Striped like hard candy. Please don't lick it.

varieties.name: Frost
varieties.blurb: Cold to the touch, so bring mittens.

varieties.name: Patchwork
varieties.blurb: Stitched from scraps of every color in the patch.

varieties.name: Atlantic Giant
varieties.blurb: So big the county fair would want to weigh it.

varieties.name: Galaxy
varieties.blurb: A tiny universe inside. Stars may fall out.

varieties.name: Gilded
varieties.blurb: Gold all the way through, or so it looks.

varieties.name: Glass
varieties.blurb: Clear as a window, so carve it gently.

secrets.name: Hollow Moon
secrets.blurb: Cratered and faintly glowing, like it fell off the moon.

secrets.name: Spider Silk
secrets.blurb: Wrapped in silver web. The spiders won't say why.

secrets.name: Bone White
secrets.blurb: Smooth as old ivory, with a crack or two of history.

secrets.name: Witch's Brew
secrets.blurb: Bubbling green. Stir clockwise, never counter.

secrets.name: Pirate's Gold
secrets.blurb: Buried for a century. X marked this very spot.

secrets.name: Mushroom Cap
secrets.blurb: Red with white spots. Fairies use it as a porch.

secrets.name: Storm Charged
secrets.blurb: Struck by lightning and still crackling. Don't touch.

secrets.name: Ghost Gourd
secrets.blurb: You can almost see through it. Almost.

secrets.name: Bat Wing
secrets.blurb: Velvet purple. Sleeps upside down, hangs out at dusk.

secrets.name: Owl Feather
secrets.blurb: Soft as down and wiser than it looks.

secrets.name: Ember
secrets.blurb: Charcoal skin with a fire still glowing inside.

secrets.name: Aurora
secrets.blurb: Northern lights rolled into one shimmering pumpkin.
